country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US, GB, AU, NZ

source_kind.description: Where the lead came from, so reports can compare yield per source. Prefer curated IMG sources over general web search.

screen.description: One-page check made before any scraping. `outreach scrape` reads a provider only when program_open, outreach_allowed and in_country are true and refuses_imgs is not true.

accepts_imgs.description: The page states the program is open to international students or graduates. Recorded for ranking; false (silent) does not fail the screen

refuses_imgs.description: The page says the program does not take international students or graduates. Fails the screen

program_open.description: Applications are currently accepted (not suspended, paused or partner-schools only)

outreach_allowed.description: The site does not forbid unsolicited contact or third-party agencies

in_country.description: The provider operates in the batch's country

evidence_url.description: The page the four answers were judged from

note.description: Why a check failed, or anything the extractor should know

contactable.description: Optional, never gating: the program or staff page names a coordinator or director (with or without an email). Used by targeting profiles.
